address: 4F, Four Seasons Hotel, 8 Finance Street, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Quality produce is sourced from all over the world to make sophisticated Cantonese dishes. Dim sum lunch is a delight; so is their hearty double-boiled soups brimming with ingredients. On top of the main menu, seasonal offerings are also worth checking out. Enjoy the food with organic sparkling teas or ask the sommelier about wine pairings. The room commands panoramic harbour views and is popular among locals and seasoned travellers alike....
